 Both the Patriots and the Packers have taken their lumps thus far this season. But with matching 5-3 records, they look to have gotten through the storm.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement New England has looked solid as of late, winning for of its last five games. After a rocky start to the year, Drake Maye looks to have stabilized his form, amassing 17 touchdowns to two interceptions during that stretch.
 Green Bay finds itself in identical form, downing four of its last five foes. Matt Lafleur has found a winning formula as of late, with Jordan Love, Christian Watson and Matthew Golden all enjoying standout campaigns thus far.
 With that, here's how you can listen to Patriots vs. Packers radio coverage on Sunday.
 Patriots vs. Packers radio coverage
 Radio station: SiriusXM app and channels 192, 261
 Listen to live play-by-play coverage of Patriots vs. Packers nationwide on the SiriusXM app, or in your vehicle on channels 192 (Patriots broadcast) and 261 (Packers broadcast).
